name: getsockopt
synopsis: int getsockopt(int sockfd, int level, int optname, void *optval, socklen_t *optlen);
description: The getsockopt() function retrieves the options associated with a socket specified by the file descriptor sockfd. It allows querying options at various protocol levels by specifying the level and option name. The function stores the option value in a provided buffer.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: The protocol level at which the option resides, such as SOL_SOCKET

parameters.name: optname
parameters.description: The name of the option to retrieve

parameters.name: optval
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where the option value will be stored

parameters.name: optlen
parameters.description: Pointer to the size of the optval buffer, updated on return

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The argument sockfd is not a valid file descriptor
The address pointed to by optval or optlen is not in a valid part of the process address space
optlen is invalid or an invalid value in optval
The option is unknown at the level indicated
The file descriptor sockfd does not refer to a socket

bugs: Several of the socket options should be handled at lower levels of the system.
